method: grep on inline style + computed style probe via playwright @ 1440x900

background.description: Primary page background — off-white, used on body and most surfaces

softGray.description: Soft gray surface — secondary card backgrounds

borderGray.description: Subtle hairline borders, dividers, inactive states

tertiary.description: Tertiary text — captions, fine print, low-priority labels

secondary.description: Secondary text — meta, eyebrows, supporting copy

near.description: Near-black — primary text on light backgrounds

primary.description: Headings ink + dark surface fill — almost-black, used for hero h1, dark footer band

accentBlue.description: Selected-state accent — appears in user-agent ::selection / focus only; not used in chrome

darkOverlay.description: Image hover/scrim overlay (dark band on hero gallery cards)

container.note: page-edge padding scales aggressively from 16px (≤939) → 40px (940-1439) → 100px (≥1440). content rect width on desktop ≈ 1240px

topPadding.note: top padding above hero h1 — found as `padding:120px 16px`, `120px 40px 60px`, `160px 100px`, `160px 40px`

notes.general: moment.framer.photos is a light-only photographer-portfolio framer template. palette is monochrome warm-neutrals (off-white background → near-black ink) with zero brand color in the chrome. accent blue only surfaces in browser ::selection.
notes.containerSystem: framer canvas uses 1440 as the desktop reference; content width is ~1240px (1440 minus 100px each side). 940px is the tablet/desktop split, 940px is also the mobile/tablet split — only two breakpoints, not three.
notes.tokensVsHardcoded: 10 distinct framer color tokens, all light-mode. 11th appearance #060606 is reused under two token ids (a4438c6e + aa3e4767) — likely 'fg-primary' and 'surface-dark' that happen to share a hex.
notes.uncertainty: spacing 'stack/gap' values are inferred from grep'd inline styles + a few measurements; framer doesn't expose a token system for spacing the way it does for color. treat these as observed patterns, not declared tokens.
